mxCell.value: ASTRA - Main Server Data Flow Diagram
Web Browser / Client HTTP / HTTPS Requests
Telescope Hardware Python WebSocket Client
security/middleware.py - Security Layer
IP Blacklist Check (ip_blacklist.py)
CSRF Protection (Flask-WTF CSRFProtect)
SecurityMiddleware Request Validation (error 403 if blocked)
force_https() HTTP→HTTPS Redirect (before_request)
app/WebsocketServer.py - WebSocket Server (Ports 4000 & 8000)
register_client_handler() POST /client/register Input: certificate_data Output: {token, client_id}
authenticate_token_with_policy() Input: token string Verify via token_store Output: record or (None, reason)
handle_client() WebSocket message loop Input: websocket, path JSON msg dispatch
ClientManager Manage connected clients command(client_id, fn, args) Disconnect / list
send_command_handler() POST /sendCommand Input: {client_id, command, args} Output: telescope RPC response
liveview_handler() GET /liveview/<client_id> WebSocket upgrade Streams camera frames
admin_disconnect_ws_client_handler() POST /admin/ws/disconnect/<id> Input: client_id Force disconnect
Server.py - Flask Application Core
load_dotenv() Load instance/.env Flask config, DB URL, Email creds, SSL
force_https() before_request hook Redirect HTTP→HTTPS Skip for localhost
enforce_enabled_account() before_request hook Logout disabled users Flash message + redirect
load_user(user_id) Flask-Login callback Input: str user_id Output: User | None
register_blueprints() Auto-scan controllers/ Import each blueprint Register with Flask app
handle_csrf_error(e) CSRFError handler Log headers/origin/path Return JSON 400
send_command() POST /sendCommand Delegate to WS server Output: telescope response
liveview(client_id) GET /liveview/<id> Delegate to WS server Camera stream
register_client() POST /client/register Delegate to WS server Output: {token, client_id}
generate_routes_file() Build templates/routes.txt Filter out admin/API routes For navigation menus
db.create_all() SQLAlchemy init Create tables on startup Apply schema migrations
start_websocket_servers() Background thread Launch async event loops Ports 4000 & 8000
controllers/auth.py - Authentication
login() GET /login → form POST /login In: username, password, trust_device Out: redirect (home or 2FA) Check: bcrypt, trusted device, IP
register() GET/POST /register In: username, email, password CAPTCHA optional Out: create User, auto-login Gen: TOTP secret, encrypt email
forgot_password() GET/POST /forgot_password In: email + CAPTCHA Find user by email Out: JWT reset token (email or display if local)
reset_password(token) GET/POST /reset_password/<t> In: new password Verify JWT (exp 1800s) Out: update bcrypt hash
login_2fa() GET/POST /login/2FA In: 6-digit TOTP code Verify via user.verify_2fa_code() Optional: trust device Out: login_user(), set cookie
logout() GET /logout In: session Out: clear session Preserve trusted_device cookie
revoke_device(device_id) POST /revoke_device/<id> In: device_id, current_user Out: delete TrustedDevice
device_info() GET /device_info Out: JSON {fingerprint, name} Debug: trust status, expiry
controllers/contact.py - Support Tickets
support_home() GET /support Out: render support.html
support_tickets() GET /support/tickets Login required In: current_user Out: user ticket list
contact_form() GET /contact Prefill email if logged in Out: render contact.html
submit_contact() POST /contact In: email, title, type, message, attachment, metadata CAPTCHA optional Validate file type Create ContactMessage + ContactMessageEntry Out: JSON {status}
ticket_view() GET /contact/<id> In: contact_id, current_user Load ticket + entries Out: render support.html
ticket_reply() POST /contact/<id>/reply In: body, attachment Create ContactMessageEntry (author=user) Out: redirect
contact_upload() POST /contact/upload In: file (PNG,JPG,LOG,TXT,FITS) Validate, save to uploads/ Out: JSON {file_path}
get_night_mode() / set_night_mode() GET|POST /user/night_mode In: night_mode bool Out: {status, night_mode}
controllers/admin.py - Admin Panel
admin() GET /admin Admin only Out: dashboard, all users, tickets, WS clients, blacklist
admin_users() GET /admin/users Out: all User records table
set_role(user_id) POST /admin/user/<id>/set_role In: new role Out: update AccountType
delete_user(user_id) POST /admin/user/<id>/delete Cascade delete sessions, trusted devices, tickets Out: redirect
enable_user() / disable_user() POST /admin/user/<id>/enable|disable In: reason (optional) Create AccountStatusHistory Out: update is_enabled_flag
admin_user_detail() GET /admin/user/<id> Out: user details, status history, tickets
blacklist_add() / blacklist_remove() POST /admin/blacklist/add|remove In: ip_address Manage IP blacklist Out: redirect
reply_contact(contact_id) POST /admin/contact/<id>/reply In: reply_text, status Create ContactMessageEntry (author=admin) Update ticket status
ws_disconnect(client_id) POST /admin/ws/disconnect/<id> In: client_id Force WS disconnect Out: redirect
contact_status(contact_id) POST /admin/contact/<id>/status In: status Update ticket status Out: redirect
controllers/star_map.py - Planetarium
get_stars() GET /api/stars In: datetime, minMag, maxMag, mag, limit, include_planets Query: HDSTARtable, NGCtable, IndexTable, PlanetsTable Out: [{name,ra,dec,mag,type}]
get_stars_meta() GET /api/stars_meta Query all star tables Out: {minMag, maxMag}
get_planets() GET /api/planets In: datetime (ISO, default=now) Call getAllCelestialData() Out: [{name,ra,dec,mag,type}] (Sun, Moon, planets)
star_map() GET /StarMap Out: render star_map.html (planetarium viewer)
star_info(star_name) GET /star_info/<name> Query all catalogs Out: JSON star details
is_local_connection() util: check request IP 127.x, 10.x, 192.168.x Out: bool
verify_captcha(token) util: POST to Cloudflare Turnstile API Out: bool success
controllers/interface.py - Telescope Control
interface() GET /interface/ Login required Check telescope in session Out: render interface.html
get_telescopes() GET /interface/get_telescopes Query Telescope table Check is_telescope_online() Out: [{id, type, online}]
select_telescope() POST /interface/select_telescope In: telescopeId Store in session Out: {status, telescope{}}
get_camera_choices() GET /interface/get_camera_choices RPC to telescope via WS Out: available shutter/ISO
update_camera() POST /interface/update_camera In: telescopeId, shutterSpeed, iso Send RPC via telescopeLink Out: {status, message}
search_object() POST /interface/search_object In: searchValue (star/NGC/HD/M) Query HDSTARtable, NGCtable, IndexTable + ephemeris Out: {Name,RA,DEC,V-Mag}
take_photo() POST /interface/take_photo In: telescopeId RPC: camera.capture_photo() Out: {status: success|error}
live_view_page() GET /interface/liveview Out: render with client_id Connects to WS liveview stream
telescopeLink.Telescope send_command(name, *args) POST localhost:5000/sendCommand Bridge: controller→WS
controllers/upload.py - File Upload

upload_file() POST /upload In: multipart/form-data Filename: <user_id>_<name.ext> Allowed: JPG,PNG,CR2,NEF,ARW FITS,DNG,HEIC,BMP,TIFF,WEBP Secure filename, save to camera_photos/<user_id>/ Out: JSON {status, message}
controllers/album.py - Photo Gallery
album() GET /album Login required List camera_photos/<user_id>/ Out: render album.html
album_photo(filename) GET /album/photo/<f> In: filename Serve from camera_photos/ Out: send_file()
album_photo_delete() POST /album/photo/delete In: filename | files[] Delete from user folder Out: {deleted[], failed[]}
album_zip() POST /album/zip Zip all user photos Stream as attachment Out: download .zip
controllers/downloads.py - Software Downloads
downloads_home() GET /downloads Scan downloads/ folder Out: render downloads.html + list of .zip releases
downloads_latest() GET /downloads/latest Find most recent release Out: send_file() download
downloads_version(version) GET /downloads/<version> In: version string Find matching zip Out: send_file() or 404
controllers/security.py - Security & Tokens
get_csrf_token() GET /security/csrf-token Generate CSRF token Set double-submit cookie Out: JSON {csrfToken}
tokens() GET /security/tokens In: current_user List user API tokens Out: render tokens.html
tokens_generate() POST /security/tokens/generate Create new API token Store hash in Telescope table Out: {token_id, prefix}
tokens_revoke(token_id) POST /security/tokens/revoke/<id> In: token_id Clear token from Telescope Out: redirect
tokens_show() GET /security/tokens/show Show full token (once only) Out: {token}
controllers/profile.py - User Profile
profile() GET /profile Login required Out: render profile.html + account info
account_info() GET /profile/account_info Out: user details page
edit_profile() GET/POST /profile/edit In: email | password Verify current password Update + flash Out: redirect
profile_trusted_devices() GET /profile/trusted_devices Out: list TrustedDevice for current user
profile_revoke_device(device_id) POST /profile/revoke_device/<id> In: device_id Delete TrustedDevice record
disable_account() POST /profile/disable_account Verify password Set is_enabled=False Create AccountStatusHistory Logout user
controllers/home.py & about.py & error.py
home() GET /home Out: render home.html
about() / tos() / privacy() GET /about GET /about/tos GET /about/privacy Out: static pages
not_found(e) 404 handler Out: render errors/404.html
method_not_allowed(e) 405 handler Out: render errors/405.html
internal_error(e) 500 handler Out: render errors/500.html
service-worker.js PWA offline support Cache static assets static/js/service-worker.js
csrf-protection.js Add CSRF token to AJAX Fetch /security/csrf-token static/js/csrf-protection.js
Utility & Algorithm Modules
utility/emailer.py send_email(to, subject, body) SMTP via Flask-Mail Zoho (smtp.zoho.eu:587) Auth, Support, Default senders
utility/encryption.py EncryptedString type Fernet symmetric encryption Transparent get/set Key from instance/.env
utility/hash.py hash_password(pwd) check_password(pwd, hash) bcrypt rounds=12 Used by User model
algorithms/astroTools.py calculate_position(ra,dec,dt) Convert RA/Dec to Az/Alt For given time & location
algorithms/ephemeris/*.py getAllCelestialData(dt) VSOP87 planetary positions Moon, Sun, planets Input: datetime Out: [{name,ra,dec,mag}]
app/telescopeLink.py Telescope(telescope_id) send_command(name, *args) POST /sendCommand (internal) Bridge ctrl→WS server
security/token_store.py verify_token(token) SHA256 hash token Query Telescope by token_hash Out: record | (None, reason)
security/manage_tokens.py generate_token(telescope_id) Revoke: clear token_hash Store hash + prefix In Telescope record
User.get_reset_token() User.verify_reset_token() JWT (itsdangerous) Expiry: 1800 seconds Payload: {user_id}
User.generate_totp_code() User.verify_2fa_code(code) Random 6-digit code Stored encrypted in DB Clear on success
TrustedDevice.trust_device() TrustedDevice.is_device_trusted() Fingerprint: SHA256(UA+IP+lang) Expiry: 30 days Cookie: trusted_device_token
security/ip_blacklist.py add_to_blacklist(ip) remove_from_blacklist(ip) check_blacklist(ip) → bool Persisted in JSON/DB
models/ - SQLAlchemy ORM Models
models/user.py - User

id: int (PK) username: str (unique) email: EncryptedString password: str (bcrypt) AccountType: str totp_secret: EncryptedString current_2fa_code: EncryptedString night_mode: bool is_enabled_flag: bool
Methods: get_email() set_email() generate_totp_code() verify_2fa_code() is_enabled() set_enabled() get_reset_token() verify_reset_token() is_admin is_standard is_limited
models/user.py - AccountStatusHistory
id: int (PK) user_id: int (FK→User) enabled: bool changed_by: int (FK→User) reason: EncryptedString changed_at: datetime
user: relationship→User Records every enable/disable event with who did it and optional reason
models/trusted_device.py - TrustedDevice
id: int (PK) user_id: int (FK→User) device_fingerprint: str device_name: str created_at: datetime expires_at: datetime last_used: datetime
Methods: trust_device(user_id, days) is_device_trusted(user_id) generate_device_fingerprint() revoke_device(device_id)
models/contact.py - ContactMessage

id: int (PK) user_id: int (FK→User, nullable) email: EncryptedString message_type: str message: EncryptedString file_path: str metadata_json: EncryptedString created_at: datetime status: new|in_progress|resolved|closed admin_response: EncryptedString responded_at: datetime
entries: relationship→ContactMessageEntry meta (property): parse metadata JSON
models/contact_thread.py - ContactMessageEntry

id: int (PK) contact_id: int (FK→ContactMessage) author: str (user|admin) user_id: int (FK→User, nullable) subject: EncryptedString body: EncryptedString file_path: str original_filename: EncryptedString created_at: datetime
user: relationship→User Each threaded reply in a support ticket thread
models/tables.py - Telescope
id: int (PK) telescope_id: str (unique) ip_address: str type: str (telescope|observer) last_seen: float (unix ts) token_hash: str (SHA256) token_prefix: str (first 16) token_created_at: datetime
Methods: get_all_telescopes() is_telescope_online() (5min) add_telescope() update_last_seen() update_ip_address() remove_telescope()
models/tables.py - Star Catalogs
HDSTARtable ('HDSTARTable') Henry Draper catalog Fields: Name, RA, DEC, V-Mag, commonNames query_by_name() query_by_name_flexible() query_by_common_name()
NGCtable ('NGCtable') New General Catalog + Messier objects Fields: Name, RA, DEC, V-Mag query_by_name() query_by_messier() query_by_common_name()
IndexTable ('IndexTable') IC (Index Catalog) Objects Fields: Name, RA, DEC query_by_name()
PlanetsTable ('PlanetsTable') Planetary ephemeris Computed at runtime query_by_name() load_planets()

SQLite Database instance/Data.db
Tables: user, account_status_history, trusted_device, contact_message, contact_message_entry, telescopes, HDSTARTable, IndexTable, NGCtable, PlanetsTable
